info.title: host/access/v1/access.proto
info.description:
The access interface: who may act on one collection, one document or one
exact version of it, beyond what their role on an installation reaches.
The host writes and answers every grant; the module that serves the kind
asks, forwarding the caller's Work Context and attesting where the resource
sits (its owner, and the collections above it) from its own durable rows.
A module stores no grant of its own and registers no document here.

Every request carries the caller's Work Context as the module received it
and the module's own workload credential, and nothing else names who is
asking: the tenant, the viewer, the actor chain and the binding are read
from the verified Work Context alone. The module asking is the one module
serving every kind its request names.
